protocol.support_rule: v14 manifest seed 0 k4 ref_rel; each fold holds one ref out
protocol.candidate_rule: the three remaining clean support images only
protocol.facility_objective: candidate-pool all 3*256 cells -> selected image subset mean min(1-cosine)
protocol.synthetic_mask: native 1024 x 1024; no grid threshold or mask downsample
protocol.normal_nuisance_keys: all 15 cache keys; fixed 4-stride 16-cell lattice per image
protocol.memory_rule: all 256 cells of each selected image; no patch deletion
protocol.claim_boundary: exploratory support proxy only; no paper confirmation

selection.objective: mean over candidate-pool cells of min(1 - cosine) to selected image cells
